about_short_description.short_description: CrowdVolt is a platform that allows fans to swap tickets to live events via a two-sided, bid-ask marketplace, starting with EDM events.

product.name: CrowdVolt Ticket Exchange Marketplace
product.description: A platform enabling fans to buy and sell live event tickets through a two-sided bid-ask marketplace focused on EDM events.

product.name: Automated Ticket Transfer Service
product.description: A service that automates the transfer of tickets between buyers and sellers to ensure secure and timely delivery.

product.name: Payment Processing via Stripe
product.description: Integration with Stripe to securely process payments between buyers and sellers on the platform.

product.name: Community Reviews and Ratings
product.description: A feature allowing users to provide and view reviews and ratings of tickets and sellers to inform purchase decisions.

product.name: Customer Support Service
product.description: A 24/7 support service providing assistance to users for issues related to ticket buying, selling, and platform use.
